items.followUp: Define density and write its SI unit.

accept: force acting normally per unit area
rubric.why: Pressure is the force acting normally per unit area.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining pressure as force per unit area.

rubric.why: The pascal is the SI unit of pressure and is equivalent to a newton per square metre.
rubric.description: States the SI unit of pressure.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving pascal (Pa) or an equivalent unit.

modelAnswer: Pressure is the force acting normally per unit area of a surface.
Its SI unit is the pascal (Pa), equal to N m⁻².

items.followUp: State two rules for identifying significant figures in a measured quantity.

rubric.why: Every non-zero digit in a number is significant.
rubric.description: Gives the rule for non-zero digits.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that all non-zero digits are significant.

accept: zeros between nonzero digits are significant
rubric.why: Leading zeros are not significant, while zeros between non-zero digits are significant.
rubric.description: Gives a correct rule about zeros.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating a valid rule about zeros.

modelAnswer: All nonzero digits in a number are significant.
Leading zeros are not significant; zeros between nonzero digits are significant.
